# Bdo

I build tools for people and AI to model work, make changes, and inspect the results.

My current projects explore local-first software, visual modeling, programming tools, and generative worlds. I care about clear permissions, reproducible behavior, and keeping a record that another person can follow.

These are projects in development. Each repository explains what works, what remains experimental, and how to try it.

## Selected projects

| Project | What it does | Current state |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [schematically](https://github.com/bdf1992/schematically) | Edit connected schematic models visually or through an API. | [Working 0.1 editor](https://github.com/bdf1992/schematically/blob/main/README.md) |
| [Soveraeign](https://github.com/bdf1992/Soveraeign) | Local-first records, permissions, and operations shared by people and AI. | [Experimental operating environment](https://github.com/bdf1992/Soveraeign/blob/main/STATUS.yaml) |
| [ide](https://github.com/bdf1992/ide) | A browser IDE with Python execution and revision-aware chat patches. | [Side-panel prototype](https://github.com/bdf1992/ide/blob/main/STATUS.md) |
| [small-world](https://github.com/bdf1992/small-world) | Generate and inspect repeatable worlds from content, seeds, and search budgets. | [M0.6 prototype; M0.7 under revision](https://github.com/bdf1992/small-world/pull/20) |
| [familiar](https://github.com/bdf1992/familiar) | Validate skill collections and preserve evidence behind agent guidance. | [Experimental workbench](https://github.com/bdf1992/familiar/blob/main/REPOSITORY_AUDIT.md) |
| [HowDo](https://github.com/bdf1992/HowDo) | A Claude Code plugin for understanding a problem and checking the work. | [Plugin; RC hardening under review](https://github.com/bdf1992/HowDo/pull/30) |

Start with **Schematically** for the visual editor, or **Soveraeign** for the system behind governed work. Each project has its own implementation and acceptance boundaries.
